label: a6
tail:
I'm executing the wave-5 A6 audit as Alpha. Status so far:

**Recovery and entry state.** A4 is now clear (13/13) — the two blockers I recorded at the earlier A4-concurrence dispatch were closed before this one. A6 entered blocked on four gates, all mine.

**The halt record undercounts again.** `gates.mjs` printed 4 / 6 / 6 failures; re-running each tool directly gives **11 `published-unaudited`, 131 `risk-review-missing`, 8 `receipt-seed-missing`**. Every count I'm working from is a direct tool run.

**Handoffs.** The pure/material split arrived (198 pure / 11 material, spot-checked against `impact-audit`'s 209 changed interfaces — no gap). Stage snapshots arrived, but with **nine per-item snapshots the Betas took**, which §7.4 reserves to the orchestrator; nine is far short of wave 2's 267 so I used the ledger as-is and recorded it as a process finding. **The URL liveness table was not handed over** — I ran it myself.

**Done so far:**
- **URL sweep:** 143 URLs, 139 live. The 61 Wikipedia "failures" were this host being rate-limited, not dead links — re-swept paced, 60 recovered. Two genuine 404s repaired (dead nLab page removed; the Gillman–Jerison book repointed from a nonexistent Wikipedia article to the publisher record). One unreachable host (`math.wvu.edu`, 20 items) recorded but **not** repaired — I can't distinguish withdrawn from unreachable-from-here, and all 20 carry another live URL. N1 from my earlier report turns out to be a **144-item** corpus-wide convention, already on the owner queue — downgraded to nonfatal, not repaired.
- **Impact receipt: passing.** 1,386 consumers — 1,340 disposed wholesale as pure-retag class, 46 individually. The load-bearing check was mechanical, not from Beta reports: in 10 of the 11 material items the claim section and title are **byte-identical** to HEAD; the eleventh changed its Example body and has zero consumers.
- **Cross-batch (29) and forward (20) edges read personally** — clean. Cross-batch reduces to 4 distinct targets; I checked each citing restatement against the target's Statement, including `thm-dini`'s four hypotheses.
- **Both decayed-prose repairs verified.** `rem-function-space-conventions` and `thm-the-exponential-law` had claimed general compactness is developed *later* in the reading order — true when written, false since. I confirmed the replacement text against `thm-compactness-agrees-with-metric-compactness`, `lem-tube-lemma-for-a-compact-factor` and `def-compact-open-topology` on disk.

**Running now:** 192 read-only DeepSeek refuter calls — 131 high/critical items, 58 packed citation-precision tables covering all 1,427 leaving-batch edges, 3 material items the risk tiers missed. 26 complete, **zero fatal findings so far**; the nonfatals are the unused-dependency class. Roughly 3 hours to drain at the lane's cap of 8, which I checked against memory rather than raising.

Certification of the 11 material repairs waits for that to finish, since a certifier must read final text.
